body:
The following bug report was made with AI.

### Problem

A short-lived Nvim process started inside `:terminal` can exit with status 1 after a `--listen` startup failure while the terminal buffer never displays the fatal stderr line. The visible result is only `[Process exited 1]`, even though the child should have printed:

```text
nvim: Failed to --listen: address already in use: "..."
More info with "nvim -h"
```

This appears to be the same bug class as #34365 after the #38027 fix was reverted by #38175 because of #38172. The symptom also matches the broader PTY-after-exit output-loss issue described in #37982: process exit is observed and the terminal-close marker is rendered before all final PTY output is reliably read and rendered.

Example CI failure:

```text
FAILED .../test/functional/terminal/tui_spec.lua @ 55:
TUI exit status 1 and error message with server --listen error #34365

Expected (anywhere): "nvim: Failed to %-%-listen: address already in use:"
Actual:
  |^                                                            |
  |[Process exited 1]                                          |
  |                                                            |
  |                                                            |
  |                                                            |
  |{5:-- TERMINAL --}                                              |
```

The failing code path is roughly:

```c
// src/nvim/msgpack_rpc/server.c
if (server_start(listen_addr) != 0) {
  snprintf(IObuff, IOSIZE, "Failed to --listen: ...");
  return false;
}

// src/nvim/main.c
if (!server_init(params.listen_addr)) {
  mainerr(IObuff, NULL, NULL);
}

print_mainerr(...) {
  fprintf(stderr, "nvim: Failed to --listen: ...\n");
}

os_exit(1);
```

The embedding terminal then observes process exit, drains PTY streams, and calls terminal-close handling that produces `[Process exited 1]`. The bug is that the exit marker can win while the final stderr output is missing from the terminal buffer.

### Steps to reproduce

One observed trigger is the existing functional test:

```text
test/functional/terminal/tui_spec.lua
TUI exit status 1 and error message with server --listen error #34365
```

The scenario is:

```text
1. Start a host Nvim test session with a listening server.
2. In a `:terminal` buffer, start a child Nvim using `--listen` with the host's already-used server address.
3. The child exits with status 1.
4. The terminal buffer can show `[Process exited 1]` without the preceding `nvim: Failed to --listen: address already in use:` stderr line.
```

The test expectation is:

```lua
screen:expect({ any = vim.pesc('[Process exited 1]') })
screen:expect({
  any = vim.pesc('nvim: Failed to --listen: address already in use:'),
  unchanged = true,
})
```


### Expected behavior

The terminal buffer should retain and display the fatal startup stderr before or along with `[Process exited 1]`. A failed child process must not lose the startup error line merely because the process exits quickly.


### Nvim version (nvim -v)

v0.13.0-dev

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

n/a

### Operating system/version

GitHub Actions Ubuntu 24.04.

### Terminal name/version

n/a

### $TERM environment variable

n/a

### Installation

Built from the Neovim repository in CI.
